name: Drink Offering
overview: The drink offering, as detailed in Numbers 15:3-8, was an integral part of the sacrificial system, accompanying burnt offerings and other sacrifices with a prescribed quantity of wine poured out as a sweet savor to the LORD. This act symbolized devotion and was carefully regulated, reflecting the solemnity and reverence due in worship. The specific measures for each offering underscore the intentionality and order God required in approaching Him through sacrifice.
